description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: flood hazard datasets (pprl pays) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PPRL Pays des Olonnes - Aléas des risques inondation et du Pays des Ol; PPRL Pays des Olonnes - Cotes de référence 2100 des risques inondation; PPRL Pays des Olonnes - Enjeux surfaciques des risques inondation et d; PPRL Pays des Olonnes - Enjeux ponctuels des risques inondation et du . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
